classes.name: IntAna2d_AnaIntersection
classes.summary:
Implementation of the analytical intersection between:
- two Lin2d,
- two Circ2d,
- a Lin2d and a Circ2d,
- an element of gp (Lin2d, Circ2d, Elips2d, Parab2d, Hypr2d) and another conic. No tolerance is given for all the intersections: the tolerance will be the "precision machine".

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns TRUE if the computation was successful.

instanceMethods.name: IsEmpty
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns TRUE when there is no intersection, i-e.
- no intersection point
- the elements are not identical. The element may be parallel in this case.

instanceMethods.name: IdenticalElements
instanceMethods.comment: For the intersection between an element of gp and a conic known by an implicit equation, the result will be TRUE if the element of gp verifies the implicit equation. For the intersection between two Lin2d or two Circ2d, the result will be TRUE if the elements are identical. The function returns FALSE in all the other cases.

instanceMethods.name: ParallelElements
instanceMethods.comment: For the intersection between two Lin2d or two Circ2d, the function returns TRUE if the elements are parallel. The function returns FALSE in all the other cases.

instanceMethods.name: NbPoints
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of IntPoint between the 2 curves.

instanceMethods.name: Point
instanceMethods.comment: returns the intersection point of range N; If (N<=0) or (N>NbPoints), an exception is raised.

classes.name: IntAna2d_Conic
classes.summary: Definition of a conic by its implicit quadaratic equation: A.X**2 + B.Y**2 + 2.C.X*Y + 2.D.X + 2.E.Y + F = 0.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: value of the function F at the point X,Y.

instanceMethods.name: Grad
instanceMethods.comment: returns the value of the gradient of F at the point X,Y.

instanceMethods.name: ValAndGrad
instanceMethods.signature: (X: number, Y: number, Val: number, Grd: gp_XY): { Val: number }

instanceMethods.name: Coefficients
instanceMethods.signature: (A: number, B: number, C: number, D: number, E: number, F: number): { A: number; B: number; C: number; D: number; E: number; F: number }
instanceMethods.returnType: { A: number; B: number; C: number; D: number; E: number; F: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
returns the coefficients of the polynomial equation which defines the conic: A.X**2 + B.Y**2 + 2.C.X*Y + 2.D.X + 2.E.Y + F = 0.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `A`: updated value from the call.
- `B`: updated value from the call.
- `C`: updated value from the call.
- `D`: updated value from the call.
- `E`: updated value from the call.
- `F`: updated value from the call.

instanceMethods.name: NewCoefficients
instanceMethods.signature: (A: number, B: number, C: number, D: number, E: number, F: number, Axis: gp_Ax2d): { A: number; B: number; C: number; D: number; E: number; F: number }
instanceMethods.returnType: { A: number; B: number; C: number; D: number; E: number; F: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the coefficients of the polynomial equation ( written in the natural coordinates system ) A x x + B y y + 2 C x y + 2 D x + 2 E y + F in the local coordinates system defined by Axis.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `A`: updated value from the call.
- `B`: updated value from the call.
- `C`: updated value from the call.
- `D`: updated value from the call.
- `E`: updated value from the call.
- `F`: updated value from the call.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Create an intersection point between a parametric 2d line, and a line given by an implicit equation (ImplicitCurve). X,Y are the coordinate of the point. U1 is the parameter on the parametric element. Empty constructor. It's necessary to use one of the SetValue method after this one.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (X: number, Y: number, U1: number, U2: number)
constructors.comment: Create an intersection point between 2 parametric 2d lines. X,Y are the coordinate of the point. U1 is the parameter on the first element, U2 the parameter on the second one.

instanceMethods.name: SecondIsImplicit

instanceMethods.name: ParamOnSecond
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter on the second element. If the second element is an implicit curve, an exception is raised.
